zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.23** 修复待处理事项计数、重复回复回执与详情入口。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 修复与优化
items: “需要你”只统计当前有效的问题、授权与明确确认。已回答、已被后续决策替代或到期的旧问题自动退出，后台任务与历史错误不再增加数字。
点击全局数字或机器人角标查看具体事项，可直接回答、授权、确认或定位原文；真正的子任务提问也纳入同一份明细。
每条用户消息只显示一个轻量“已回复”，修复关联多个任务时出现多枚“已回答”。任务来源仍保留在回复详情。
“回复详情”位于气泡左下，对齐正文文字；完成态在悬停或键盘聚焦时显示，运行时同一入口显示实际活动，预留高度避免跳动。
修复从待处理事项定位后，后续通知无法定位新消息的问题。保留 RC22 用户模型选择及已有性能修复。

zh.title: 升级与验收范围
items: 问题收尾只关闭失效操作，不改写历史正文，不批准权限，也不伪造任务完成或取消。需要完整报告的人工复核仍打开原报告。
产品回归覆盖 200 个机器人、1 万消息的源码桌面交互，并由实现者逐图自审；发布包、签名与更新清单另行核验。
升级前备份完整数据根，并同步升级 Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway。完整读屏、Windows/Linux 交互安装及长期日用不在本轮验收范围内。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.23** fixes attention counts, duplicate reply receipts and the reply details entry. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: Attention counts include only current questions, permissions and explicit confirmations. Answered, superseded or expired questions retire automatically; background work and historical errors no longer increase the count.
Open the global count or a bot badge to inspect and answer, authorize, confirm or locate each item. Actionable child-task questions use the same list.
Each user message shows one lightweight replied receipt, fixing repeated answered buttons when a reply references multiple tasks. Task sources remain in reply details.

Reply details sits below the left edge of the bubble, aligned with its text. Completed entries appear on hover or keyboard focus; active replies show factual activity through the same entry. Reserved height avoids layout shifts.
Notifications can locate a new message after navigation from attention details. Retain RC22 user model selections and previous performance fixes.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: Retiring a question disables its old actions without rewriting history, granting permissions or fabricating task completion or cancellation. Manual reviews that require a full report still open that report.

Product regression covers source desktop interactions with 200 bots and 10,000 messages, followed by implementer screenshot self-review. Published packages, signatures and update manifests receive separate checks.

Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. Full screen-reader coverage, interactive Windows/Linux installation and long-term use remain outside this acceptance scope.
